what_to_detect: A mill of more cards than the library holds mills the whole library: the card_milled count equals the library size in the snapshot before the resolution and falls short of the number instructed.
near_miss: A mill instructed against an empty library, which mills nothing.
record_fields: snapshot player library before the resolution

what_to_detect: A candidate whose cost includes milling N cards is affordable when the library holds at least N cards.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost includes milling more cards than the library holds is not affordable.

what_to_detect: An ability that milled a card reads that card in the graveyard it moved to: its effect produces an outcome set by the milled card's characteristics (mana for its coloured mana symbols, the milled card returned).
near_miss: The same kind of ability whose milled card gives nothing to read (a land, with no coloured mana symbols), so the effect produces nothing.
record_fields: the milled card's entity in the graveyard

what_to_detect: A mill a replacement effect enlarged (more cards milled than instructed) whose ability then reads every milled card, its outcome the sum over them.
near_miss: A mill of exactly the instructed number, the ability reading one card.
record_fields: rewrite record on a card_milled with result updated
